hiddenSections.title: Extension blocks on Linux
hiddenSections.text: Blocks that extensions add to the details of Deployments, Pods and Nodes (Vertical Pod Autoscaler, Trivy image scans, Kyverno policy results, the service mesh and others) were never shown on Linux since 0.30.0. They are shown again.

rollouts.title: Argo Rollouts for AI agents
rollouts.text: The Argo Rollouts extension 1.5.0 gives agents one read-only tool that diagnoses a rollout whole, tells when a canary's traffic does not reach the canary, can check how safely a canary is set up, and shows on a Deployment which Rollout uses it. Update it in Settings → Extensions; agents get the tool once you turn it on in Settings → AI agents (MCP).

coverage.title: Agents know what was not checked
coverage.text: When an agent asks for problems, Sextant also names the extensions whose problems you keep from agents, so that an empty answer is not taken for "nothing wrong".

memory.title: Steadier memory while the window is hidden
memory.text: Sextant no longer sends the window more than it has read: while a minimized or hidden window does not read, watches, logs and terminals wait instead of piling data up. Its log (About → Open logs folder) also records memory and activity counters every 10 minutes.

api5.title: Extension API 5
api5.text: Four of Sextant's own extensions now match the views they replaced: Traefik's References column, the monitors no Prometheus picks up, every Karpenter limit, and k3s's masked node arguments and chart values. Update them in Settings → Extensions.

commandValues.title: What a command may run
commandValues.text: An extension's consent window now lists the values each of its commands' parameters may take.

extensionsMoved.title: Views of cluster tools are now extensions
extensionsMoved.text: Flux, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, Argo Workflows, Velero, Istio, Linkerd, Knative, Traefik, Contour, Crossplane, Kyverno, CloudNativePG, Strimzi, External Secrets, Sealed Secrets, Prometheus Operator, cert-manager, Trivy, KEDA, Karpenter, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, Cluster API, k3s / RKE2, Dynamic Resource Allocation, NVIDIA GPU Operator, Kueue, JobSet, KubeRay, KServe, Operator Lifecycle Manager and OpenShift moved out of Sextant into its own extensions from the extension catalog, which are updated on their own. Install the ones you use below: until then their sections are not shown. Your notification settings for them were kept, and the sidebar also offers them in clusters that run these tools.

api4.title: Extension API 4
api4.text: Extensions can now have sidebar sections with Sextant's own tables, computed columns, one-click actions, services inside the cluster and tools for AI agents: enough to build these four views on the public API.

agentTools.title: GitOps tools for AI agents are now the extensions'
agentTools.text: The MCP tool gitops_action is gone: the Flux and Argo CD extensions give agents Reconcile, Suspend and Resume, and Sync, Refresh and Hard refresh. To let agents use them, turn on the extension's tools in Settings → AI agents (MCP).

extensions.title: Install the extensions that moved
extensions.hint: Each package is checked and asks for your consent before it is installed.
extensions.catalogOff: The extension catalog is turned off: turn it on in Settings → Extensions to install them.
